description: This file contains Redux reducers for managing custom emojis in the Mattermost application, including handling received, deleted, and non-existent emojis, and combining reducers for emoji state management.

methods.name: customEmoji
methods.description: Reducer function to handle custom emoji actions and update the emoji state.

methods.name: storeEmoji
methods.description: Helper function to add a new emoji to the state if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: storeEmojisForPost
methods.description: Helper function to store emojis associated with a post.

methods.name: nonExistentEmoji
methods.description: Reducer function to manage the set of emoji names that do not exist.
